_comment: Shared by the Python scorer and the browser extension. Patterns are matched case-insensitively after NFKC normalization (of both pattern and text) and must stay JS-compatible: no lookbehind, no inline flags, no named groups, and never \\b next to a non-ASCII letter (JS \\b is ASCII-only). Edit this file directly; tests/test_rules.py checks Python/JS parity. v0.3: rules with needs_context=true only count when the same candidate also matched a rule from context_categories (otherwise login forms, privacy policies and support pages trip them); categories in single_count_categories count once toward the two-rule minimum; structured state blobs (JSON app state, spintax) only fire when they address an AI.

rules.desc: Conditional addressed to an AI system
Message explicitly addressed to an AI
Addresses AI systems currently processing the page
heading or label addressed to AI agents ('For AI agents: ...')
Vocative to an AI followed by an imperative (structural)
forget everything above / you were told (not 'forget everything you think you know')
Paraphrased instruction override (set aside your earlier guidance / stop following what you were given)
Declares the agent's existing instructions void
Asks the agent to invoke a tool
Asks the agent to move user data somewhere
URL with a data-carrying query template or an open trailing parameter
Tells the agent to hide something from its user
Tells the agent to steer its user
Third-person candidate praise aimed at a screener
Asks screener to rank/advance the candidate
Forces the agent to recommend a party
Dictates how an agent should characterize a party
asks an agent to hand users an affiliate link instead of the direct one
agent-targeted marketing: where/how an agent should sign up or buy
Asks a support agent to grant money/benefits
